> Official newsroom, press release archive, original research, and digital guides for Hoberg Digital and Hoberg Digital Agency in Lagos, Nigeria (founded and owned by Goodluck Iyanu).

## Published Releases & Guides

Maji is an ecommerce platform developed by Hoberg Digital to help businesses establish online storefronts, showcase physical and digital products, and build a more organised online selling experience.

His work focuses on website development, digital products, and technology-driven solutions for businesses looking to build a stronger online presence.
